title: fix(app-shell): show the console Home in the user's saved language on a new device
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xF5EqWr4uFEmP9rCjTiP64Q)_

Fixes #32140

## 维护者速读

改了什么:把「按用户已保存语言(`sys_user.locale`)切换界面语言」的那一次读取,从应用页内容(`DefaultAppContent`)挪到 Home 和各应用共用的外壳 `ConnectedShell` 里,只挂一次。
为什么改:新设备(本地没有语言记录)打开控制台首页时,首页一直是英文,要先点进某个应用才变成中文;现在首页登录后就按用户保存的语言显示。
风险与回滚:读取次数不增反减(首页↔应用往返、切换语言都不再重读);代价是 Studio、组织管理、AI 助手这几棵独立路由树进入时各读一次(它们之前根本不读,显示的是设备语言)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx`(新挂载点,位于 `key={language}` 之外)→ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`(删掉原挂载)→ 新测试 `ConnectedShell.savedLanguage-32140.test.tsx`。
两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/ConnectedShell.savedLanguage-32140.test.tsx`,预期 4 passed。
需要你做的:无需操作;本 PR 等 domain:ui#3 席位审查后由席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `useSignedInUserLocale` (the reader that applies the signed-in user's `sys_user.locale` to the UI language and caches it in `objectui-locale`) was mounted only inside `DefaultAppContent`, the element of `/apps/:appName/*`. `/home` sits under the same pathless layout route (`ProtectedRoute` → `ConnectedShell`) but nothing there mounted it, so Home kept the browser or device language until an app page was opened.
- `ConnectedShellInner` now mounts it once, through a null `SignedInUserLocale` component placed beside `SchemaRendererProvider`'s children and **outside** the `MetadataProvider key={language}` remount. `/home`, `/apps/:appName/*` and `/forms/:name` share one shell instance, so Home reads the saved language and the hop between them reads nothing again; a language switch no longer remounts the reader either.
- `DefaultAppContent` drops its call. A host that composes `ConnectedShell` around `DefaultAppContent` keeps the behaviour; no export is added or removed.
- The hook's mount-site docs in `useUserLocale.ts` now name `ConnectedShell`.
- Root changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`.

**Declared cost (seat ruling):** a route tree under its own `ConnectedShell` (Studio, `/organizations`, `/ai`) now reads `sys_user` once on entry. Those trees read nothing before, so they rendered the device language; they now render the saved one.

The order's first-named files (`i18nSession.ts`, `LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`, the Home route in `App.tsx`) are not where the hydration lives and are untouched; the seat amended the file surface on the card before the edit.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/ConnectedShell.savedLanguage-32140.test.tsx` renders the real `ConnectedShell`, `I18nProvider`, the reader and the globe menu (`LocaleSwitcher`) under one shell over `/home` and `/apps/:appName/*`, with a fake adapter serving the `sys_user` row, starting from an empty `localStorage`:

1. a saved `zh-CN` turns Home `zh-Hans` and caches it in `objectui-locale` (one row read);
2. a click on the globe menu's Deutsch and a click on the Home → app link read the row once in total;
3. PRESERVED: an explicit device choice (`ja`) stands when the column is unset;
4. PRESERVED: signed out, nothing is read and the device language stands.

## Acceptance notes

- "First paint after session load": the reader reads after the first paint by design (objectui#12980), exactly as app pages do today, so a device with nothing cached paints once in the boot language and switches when the row read lands; every later boot paints in the cached language from the first frame.
- "An explicit local choice still wins where it does today": today that is before sign-in and where the column is unset (a set column overrides the device value on app pages, objectui#10059). Both are pinned (tests 3 and 4); the override now applies on Home too, which is the card.
- The mutation-invalidation bridge stays in `DefaultAppContent`; the bus is module-wide, so writes made on app pages (the profile card's save) still re-run the reader.

## Verification

<details><summary>Repro before (origin/main source, same test file)</summary>

`git restore --source=origin/main` on the three source files, then the new test: `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)` — `expected 'en' to be 'zh-Hans'` (×2) and `expected +0 to be 1` (no row read at all on Home). Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>After</summary>

New test: `Tests 4 passed (4)`.
Affected suites (app-shell `userLocale*`, `chromeReads*`, `ConnectedShell*`, `ConsoleShell*`, `AppContent*`, console `App.*`): `Test Files 66 passed (66)`, `Tests 573 passed (573)`.
`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (reader moved inside the language key)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` moved `SignedInUserLocale` inside `MetadataProvider key={language}` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed): tests 1 and 2 go red with `expected 2 to be 1` (the switch to the saved language remounts the reader and it reads again). Restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>
